fact: ITU's 2019 table of broadband strategies, policies and plans, drawn from its World Telecommunication/ICT Regulatory Database, answers 'No' to whether a policy exists for Guinea-Bissau and names none; the document gives no date for the entry beyond its 2019 publication, so 2019 is used.

The Strategic Plan of the Access and Universal Service Fund (FASU) for 2026-2031, a consultancy final report dated 24 November 2025 prepared for the regulator ARN, states it is still to be disseminated and validated in public stakeholder consultation, and sets coverage targets before 2031 of 99% of the population for 2G, 98% for 3G and 96% for 4G broadband (dated 2025-11-24 by the document's own date, as it gives no other date for the draft status).
